sentences.en: I want to see it again.

sentences.en: A bodybuilder that's a judge to look at our physique.
sentences.zh: 还有个健美运动员作为评委来检查我们的体型。

sentences.zh: 总会有一个当牙医的家伙在那儿。

sentences.en: I'm not really sure.

sentences.zh: 我想他去那儿只是为了评判他是否喜欢这些女性的长相。

sentences.zh: 他在看你的牙齿吗？

sentences.en: Well, Tuesday, they'll do two-to-one interviews with two business professionals from our community.
sentences.zh: 嗯，周二的时候，她们会与我们社区的两名商业专业人士进行二对一的面试。

sentences.en: We want to see how they present to the public.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看她们是如何向公众展示自己的。

sentences.en: And if you make that cut, you come back the next day and you wear a business suit and you go in and have interviews with judges.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过了那一轮筛选，第二天你就要回来，穿着商务套装进去接受评委的面试。

sentences.zh: 你必须了解所有的球队、所有的吉祥物、所有的城市以及所有的场上位置。

sentences.en: It sounds like an athletic competition, a beauty pageant, and a college exam all kind of rolled together.
sentences.zh: 这听起来有点像是把竞技体育比赛、选美比赛和大学考试揉合在了一起。

sentences.zh: 那么当你得知谁入选了球队时你在哪里？

sentences.zh: 我想我和其他参加选拔的朋友当时在一家墨西哥餐厅，她们拍了视频。

sentences.en: So they had a news broadcaster flash the list on the screen and they talked about each girl.
sentences.zh: 所以她们让新闻播音员把名单闪现在屏幕上，并谈论了每一个女孩。

sentences.en: And I was like shaking.
sentences.zh: 当时我简直在发抖。

sentences.en: I was so scared.
sentences.zh: 我太害怕了。

sentences.en: And then they showed my picture and I was so excited.
sentences.zh: 然后他们展示了我的照片，我兴奋极了。

sentences.en: And it was like a big, oh, finally moment because I had been waiting for the day I could try out.
sentences.zh: 那种感觉就像是一个“哦，终于”的盛大时刻，因为我一直在等待这一天的到来，等待自己能够参加选拔。

sentences.en: I've been waiting for the day I could be at Saint Station.
sentences.zh: 我一直在等待能够成为圣徒队女孩的那一天。

sentences.en: I had been, you know, going to the games and I had every calendar from every year.
sentences.zh: 我你知道的，一直在去看比赛，并且收集了每一年的日历。

sentences.en: And I would just sit at home and flip through them and be like, wow, these girls are gorgeous.
sentences.zh: 我就会坐在家里翻看它们，心想，哇，这些女孩太美了。

sentences.en: They're amazing women.

sentences.en: And to finally see my picture and be on the list of Saint Stations was just an amazing feeling.
sentences.zh: 最终看到自己的照片出现在圣徒队女孩的名单上，真是一种无与伦比的感觉。

sentences.en: So this childhood dream of yours comes true.
sentences.zh: 所以你这个童年梦想成真了。

sentences.en: Was there a moment during this time where things started to feel less positive?
sentences.zh: 在这期间有没有哪个时刻，事情开始变得没那么美好了？

sentences.zh: 我刚进队时就被告知我需要减肥。

sentences.en: The coach actually grabbed my stomach at practice and said, we need to get rid of this.
sentences.zh: 教练在训练时甚至直接抓住我的肚子说，我们得把这块赘肉减掉。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This was my very first practice, actually.
sentences.zh: 这其实是在我的第一场训练课上发生的事。

sentences.en: There was a lot of times when girls were told they need to lose weight after they had made the team.
sentences.zh: 有很多次，女孩们在入选球队后被告知她们需要减肥。

sentences.en: They say that they take us with our potential in mind.
sentences.zh: 她们说她们录取我们是带着培养潜力的眼光看的。

sentences.en: What do you do after she tells you that you have to lose this weight?
sentences.zh: 在她告诉你必须减掉这些体重之后，你该怎么做？

sentences.en: She grabs your stomach and says, we want to get rid of this.
sentences.zh: 她抓住你的肚子说，我们想把这块赘肉减掉。

sentences.en: Well, I got in the car and I cried.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我上车后就哭了。

sentences.en: But, you know, it's hard hearing that from someone.

sentences.zh: 比如说，我很不喜欢推销东西或者向别人要钱。

sentences.zh: 而且我们每场比赛前必须卖掉20本日历。

sentences.zh: 所以刚结束场地彩排，我们就得跑进去，化好妆，跑到外面去，和那些在冠军广场闲逛的各种闲杂人等打交道。

sentences.en: We had to sell these calendars.
sentences.zh: 我们必须把这些日历卖出去。

sentences.en: And I would always come back in with like 10 or 5 left.
sentences.zh: 我每次回来手里都还会剩个10本或5本左右。

sentences.en: And after I'd get hollered at, I would get pulled from the third quarter.
sentences.zh: 在我挨了一顿训之后，我就会被取消第三节的表演资格。

sentences.en: So I didn't even get to cheer the third quarter because I had to go sell the rest of my calendars.

sentences.zh: 他们会给你发这些东西吗？

sentences.en: Are they like sending you to their spray tan person and like giving you manicures?
sentences.zh: 他们会把你送去喷雾晒肤的地方，然后给你做美甲吗？

sentences.en: No, we had to get spray tans on our own as well as nails.
sentences.zh: 没有，我们得自己去做喷雾晒肤和美甲。

sentences.en: And what about your behavior off the field?
sentences.zh: 那你在场外的行为呢？

sentences.en: We couldn't, obviously we couldn't find eyes with the players.
sentences.zh: 我们不能，很显然我们不能和球员对视。

sentences.en: So we couldn't date players, hang out with players, socialize with players, message players, be in the same place as players.
sentences.zh: 所以我们不能和球员约会，不能和球员一起出去玩，不能和球员社交，不能给球员发消息，不能和球员在同一个地方。

sentences.en: We're not allowed to speak to them at all.
sentences.zh: 我们根本不被允许和他们说话。

sentences.en: And I did always think that was very strange.
sentences.zh: 我一直觉得这非常奇怪。

sentences.en: I don't actually think that that's obvious to most people.
sentences.zh: 其实我觉得大多数人并不觉得这很明显。

sentences.en: Like that wasn't obvious to me.
sentences.zh: 就像这对我来说并不明显一样。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's funny because stuff that I think is normal, the more I talk about it, people are like, wait, what?
sentences.zh: 对，这挺搞笑的，因为我觉得很正常的事情，我越是说起它，大家就越会觉得，等等，什么？

sentences.en: And I'm like, well, yeah, like obviously.
sentences.zh: 然后我就想，好吧，对啊，这不是很显然嘛。

sentences.en: So what are the rules around spending time with players, hanging out with them?
sentences.zh: 那么，关于和球员共度时光、一起出去玩，都有哪些规定？

sentences.en: What do you have to do?
sentences.zh: 你必须做什么？

sentences.en: What do you have to follow?
sentences.zh: 你必须遵守什么？

sentences.en: So we are not allowed to follow players on social media.
sentences.zh: 所以我们不被允许在社交媒体上关注球员。

sentences.en: If they follow us, we have to block them.
sentences.zh: 如果他们关注了我们，我们必须拉黑他们。

sentences.en: We're not allowed to like anything with a player in it, whether the Saints post it or one of the player's friends post it.
sentences.zh: 我们不允许点赞任何包含球员的内容，不管是圣徒队发布的还是球员朋友发布的。

sentences.en: We can't like it.
sentences.zh: 我们都不能点赞。

sentences.en: And that goes for any NFL, NBA player, not just the Saints.
sentences.zh: 这适用于任何NFL、NBA球员，不只是圣徒队。

sentences.en: It's like thousands of players, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 就像有成千上万名球员，对吧？

sentences.en: How many players are in the NFL?
sentences.zh: NFL里有多少球员？

sentences.en: Oh, a ton.
sentences.zh: 哦，一大堆。

sentences.en: I mean, there's 50 on each team.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，每个队有50个人。

sentences.en: And then you have the NBA.
sentences.zh: 然后你还有NBA。

sentences.en: So you have to specifically block all those people?
sentences.zh: 所以你得专门把所有人拉黑？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And they're the ones who are following you.
sentences.zh: 而且是他们主动关注的你。

sentences.en: So are these players...
sentences.zh: 所以这些球员……

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: It's not like I followed them.
sentences.zh: 又不是我主动关注他们的。

sentences.en: I didn't put in any effort.
sentences.zh: 我什么都没做。

sentences.en: They just followed me.
sentences.zh: 他们只是关注了我。

sentences.en: So it was my responsibility then to go back and block all of them.
sentences.zh: 所以责任就落到了我头上，我得回头把他们全拉黑。

sentences.en: So are these players breaking the rules for following you?
sentences.zh: 那这些球员关注你，算是在违规吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不算。

sentences.en: The players have no rules as far as fraternization or social media.
sentences.zh: 就私下交往或社交媒体而言，球员没有任何规定。

sentences.en: They can use their last name on their social media.
sentences.zh: 他们可以在社交媒体上使用自己的姓氏。

sentences.en: They can post as many football Saints pictures that they want.
sentences.zh: 他们想发多少橄榄球圣徒队的照片都可以。

sentences.en: They can follow us.
sentences.zh: 他们可以关注我们。

sentences.en: They can stand as close to us as they want on the football field.
sentences.zh: 在球场上，他们想离我们多近就离多近。

sentences.en: They can be anywhere that we are.
sentences.zh: 我们在哪儿，他们就能在哪儿。

sentences.en: They can talk to us.
sentences.zh: 他们可以和我们说话。

sentences.en: They can message us.
sentences.zh: 他们可以给我们发消息。

sentences.en: And the responsibility is on us to avoid contact and block them.
sentences.zh: 而责任全在我们，我们要避免接触并拉黑他们。

sentences.en: And leave somewhere that they are.
sentences.zh: 还得离开他们所在的地方。

sentences.en: So it's not against the rules for them to talk to you, to follow you, to be near you.
sentences.zh: 所以他们跟你说话、关注你、靠近你，并不算违规。

sentences.en: But it's against the rules for you to let them do that to you.
sentences.zh: 但如果你任由他们这么对你，那就是违规的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Not only is it just against the rules, you'll get a warning.
sentences.zh: 不仅是违规，你还会收到警告。

sentences.en: It's immediate termination.
sentences.zh: 直接就是开除。

sentences.en: And what's the justification for that?
sentences.zh: 那这么做的合理解释是什么？

sentences.en: Do you know?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: Like, what's the idea behind that rule?
sentences.zh: 就是，那条规定背后的想法是什么？

sentences.en: They told us the players are players.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉我们，球员就是球员。

sentences.en: Like, you can't get involved with them.
sentences.zh: 就像，你不能和他们扯上关系。

sentences.en: They're just trying to play you.
sentences.zh: 他们只是在玩弄你。

sentences.en: They don't actually care about you.
sentences.zh: 他们其实并不在乎你。

sentences.en: And then they said that the social media rules are in place to protect us.
sentences.zh: 然后他们说，制定社交媒体规则是为了保护我们。

sentences.en: They are predators.
sentences.zh: 他们是掠夺者。

sentences.en: They want to prey on us.
sentences.zh: 他们想捕食我们。

sentences.en: We're pretty girls.
sentences.zh: 我们都是漂亮的女孩。

sentences.en: They're going to want to talk to us.
sentences.zh: 他们会想和我们说话。

sentences.en: They call them predators?
sentences.zh: 他们管这叫掠夺者？

sentences.en: They call the football players predators.
sentences.zh: 他们管橄榄球运动员叫掠夺者。

sentences.en: So the people that you're cheering for, they're saying they're also predators.
sentences.zh: 所以你们在为之欢呼的人，他们说这些人也是掠夺者。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: They actually, I mean, it's in writing.
sentences.zh: 实际上，我是说，这都是白纸黑字写着的。

sentences.en: They said they are predators.
sentences.zh: 他们说他们是掠夺者。

sentences.en: They will prey on you.
sentences.zh: 他们会捕食你们。

sentences.en: So I had never been in trouble for anything all my three years on the team.
sentences.zh: 我在队里的整整三年里，从来没有惹过任何麻烦。

sentences.en: I was a captain for two years.
sentences.zh: 我当了两年的队长。

sentences.en: But at the end of the season this past year, we got an email saying that they heard that a girl was at a party with a player and that they were investigating it.
sentences.zh: 但就在去年赛季结束时，我们收到了一封邮件，说他们听说有个女孩和球员一起去参加派对，他们正在调查此事。

sentences.en: I was actually with one of the girls on the team.
sentences.zh: 其实我和队里的一个女孩在一起。

sentences.en: And we both got the email at the same time.
sentences.zh: 我们俩同时收到了邮件。

sentences.en: And we were like, oh, my gosh, who is this about?
sentences.zh: 当时我们就想，哦天哪，这是在说谁呀？

sentences.en: Somebody's in trouble.
sentences.zh: 有人要倒霉了。

sentences.en: Well, then a couple of the girls text me and said, I think this is about you.
sentences.zh: 然后队里的几个女孩给我发短信说，我觉得这说的是你。

sentences.en: Like, I heard it was you.
sentences.zh: 就像，我听说就是你。

sentences.en: So I immediately just picked the phone and I called my coach and I said, what is going on?
sentences.zh: 所以我立刻拿起电话打给我的教练，我说，到底怎么回事？

sentences.en: What is this email about?
sentences.zh: 这封邮件是什么意思？

sentences.en: People are accusing me of this.
sentences.zh: 人们在指责我做这事。

sentences.en: And she said, well, yeah, actually, it is about you.
sentences.zh: 她说，嗯，对，其实说的就是你。

sentences.en: So they're accusing you of being in the same room as football players.
sentences.zh: 所以他们指责你和橄榄球运动员共处一室。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I was being accused of being around football players at a party.
sentences.zh: 我被指责在派对上和橄榄球运动员混在一起。

sentences.en: And just to be clear, were you at this party?
sentences.zh: 为了澄清一下，你当时真的在这个派对上吗？

sentences.en: No, I was not.
sentences.zh: 没有，我不在。

sentences.en: I was actually in Orlando when that party happened.
sentences.zh: 那个派对举行的时候，我其实在奥兰多。

sentences.en: Or I think it was a concert.
sentences.zh: 或者我觉得那是一场音乐会。

sentences.en: So then I went into human resources and they immediately started questioning me about this party.
sentences.zh: 然后我去了人力资源部，他们立刻开始就这个派对盘问我。

sentences.en: And I denied it.
sentences.zh: 我否认了。

sentences.en: And they said, well, if you're going to lie about it, we'll just ask a player because they have no reason to lie.
sentences.zh: 他们说，好吧，如果你要撒谎的话，我们就去问球员，因为他们没有理由撒谎。

sentences.en: So it was kind of like the players could say whatever they wanted.
sentences.zh: 所以这就好比球员想说什么就能说什么。

sentences.en: And I had no voice in this.
sentences.zh: 在这件事上我根本没有话语权。

sentences.en: And, you know, when girls in the past have been fired for dating players, they're like shamed off the team.
sentences.zh: 而且你知道的，过去队里有女孩因为和球员约会而被开除，她们就像是被羞辱着赶出球队的。

sentences.en: It's like they're horrible representatives.
sentences.zh: 就好像她们是极坏的代表。

sentences.en: They were horrible sensations.
sentences.zh: 她们是极坏的榜样。

sentences.en: And they told me in the past that if a girl's name even came out of a player's mouth and someone heard it, the girl would have been fired.
sentences.zh: 他们过去曾告诉我，如果球员嘴里吐出一个女孩的名字并被人听到，那个女孩就会被开除。

sentences.en: So at this point, I was terrified.
sentences.zh: 所以在那个时候，我吓坏了。

sentences.en: I knew my job wasn't secure.
sentences.zh: 我知道我的饭碗不保了。

sentences.en: And they said, well, are players messaging you?
sentences.zh: 他们问，球员有给你发消息吗？

sentences.en: And I said, yes, like players message us all the time.
sentences.zh: 我说，有啊，球员一直都在给我们发消息。

sentences.en: It's not anything new.
sentences.zh: 这又不是什么新鲜事。

sentences.en: You know, we just ignore it.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们只是不理他们。

sentences.en: And then I was told to go through my followers and block anybody that was a football player that followed me.
sentences.zh: 然后我被告知要检查我的粉丝列表，把所有关注我的橄榄球运动员全部拉黑。

sentences.en: So then what happens after this HR meeting?
sentences.zh: 那这次人事部会议之后发生了什么？

sentences.en: After this HR meeting, about four days later, I posted a photo that I had gotten from a photographer from a photo shoot I did a while back.
sentences.zh: 这次人事部会议大约四天后，我发了一张照片，是一个摄影师朋友不久前给我拍的一组写真里的。

sentences.en: I needed a full body shot, you know, that showed my athleticism, my physique.
sentences.zh: 我需要一张全身照，你知道的，能展现我的运动能力和体型的照片。

sentences.en: So I had this photo and I posted on Instagram.
sentences.zh: 所以我有了这张照片，并把它发到了Instagram上。

sentences.en: I thought it was a strong looking photo.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这是一张看起来很有力量感照片。

sentences.en: What does it look like?
sentences.zh: 它看起来是什么样的？

sentences.en: I have a serious face.
sentences.zh: 我脸上带着严肃的表情。

sentences.en: I'm turned to the side.
sentences.zh: 我侧着身子。

sentences.en: It was in a lace bodysuit.
sentences.zh: 穿着一件蕾丝连体衣。

sentences.en: It showed the muscle tone in my arm and I just wanted to have an athletic looking pretty photo.
sentences.zh: 它展现了我手臂上的肌肉线条，我只是想拍一张既有运动感又好看的照片。

sentences.en: So then what happens after you post it?
sentences.zh: 那你发了之后发生了什么？

sentences.en: After I posted, I got a text from a coach that said, very poor judgment to post this photo, especially considering rumors going around about you.
sentences.zh: 我发了之后，收到了一条教练发来的短信，上面说发这张照片判断力极差，特别是考虑到当时正围绕着你有一些流言蜚语。

sentences.en: And I said, yes, ma'am, it's deleted.
sentences.zh: 我说，好的，教练，已经删了。

sentences.en: And then the next day, I found out from my mom that they had said I should just go ahead and resign.
sentences.zh: 然后第二天，我从我妈那里得知，他们说我应该直接主动辞职。

sentences.en: You should resign because you posted this photo?
sentences.zh: 你该辞职就因为你发了这张照片？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: You know, me and my mom talked about it and I said, I don't think I've done anything wrong.
sentences.zh: 我和我妈聊过这事，我说，我觉得我没做错什么。

sentences.en: I'm not going to resign.
sentences.zh: 我是不会辞职的。

sentences.en: But I wonder if that feeling is hard to dismiss though.
sentences.zh: 但我很好奇，那种感觉是不是很难挥之不去。

sentences.en: Like you feel strongly, you have not done anything wrong, but you have these people around you who have much more power than you do, who you have revered telling you that you did.
sentences.zh: 比如你内心坚信自己没有做错任何事，但你身边那些权力远比你大得多、一直以来被你崇敬的人却在告诉你，你做错了。

sentences.en: Right, right.
sentences.zh: 对，对。

sentences.en: It's like all of a sudden this picture gave me this reputation that I didn't see myself as having or people that know me don't see me this way.
sentences.zh: 就好像突然之间，这张照片给我安上了一个名声，而我自己并不觉得自己是这样的人，了解我的人也不觉得我是这样。

sentences.en: But I wonder if it like got in your head a little bit.
sentences.zh: 但我好奇这会不会有点影响到你的心态。

sentences.en: Did you, for a minute, at least see yourself through their eyes?
sentences.zh: 你哪怕有一分钟，也透过他们的眼睛来看待自己了吗？

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，会的。

sentences.en: Immediately, you know, still looking at the photo, I see it in the way they saw it, which hurts me because I've never been one to care about what other people thought.
sentences.zh: 立刻就会，你知道的，再次看着那张照片，我会用他们看待它的方式去看待它，这让我很受伤，因为我从来不在乎别人怎么想。

sentences.en: I've just kind of marched to the beat of my own drum.
sentences.zh: 我一直都是按自己的节奏生活。

sentences.en: And so to be looking at myself in a trashy way made me question my own character a little bit.
sentences.zh: 所以用一种低俗的眼光审视自己，让我对自己的人品产生了一点怀疑。

sentences.en: And then I have to be like, no, I'm not like that.
sentences.zh: 然后我必须告诉自己，不，我才不是那样的人。

sentences.en: Like, I have little girls that adore me.
sentences.zh: 你看，我有很多崇拜我的小女孩。

sentences.en: I, you know, I'm a family person.
sentences.zh: 我，你知道的，我很恋家。

sentences.en: I'm not running around sleeping with all these football players.
sentences.zh: 我没有到处跑去和这些橄榄球运动员睡觉。

sentences.en: And so to have them think that of me just because of that photo, I definitely began to question myself.
sentences.zh: 所以仅仅因为那张照片，就让他们对我有这种看法，我确实开始怀疑自己了。

sentences.en: Like, wow, maybe I am putting out the image that I'm like this, you know, right?
sentences.zh: 心想，哇，也许我真的散发出了我是这种类型的形象，对吧？

sentences.en: They made me feel like a slut, if we're being honeSt.
sentences.zh: 说实话，他们让我觉得自己像个荡妇。

sentences.en: And so I called my coach and I said, I know that you have asked for me to resign, but I'm not going to.
sentences.zh: 所以我给教练打电话说，我知道你要求我辞职，但我不会辞的。

sentences.en: And she said, so would you like to request a meeting with Human Resources?
sentences.zh: 她说，那你想要求跟人力资源部开个会吗？

sentences.en: And I said, yes.
sentences.zh: 我说，好。

sentences.en: And so me and my mom went to the meeting and I sat down and he said, so you've requested a meeting with me.
sentences.zh: 于是我和我妈去开了会，我坐下来，他说，所以你要求跟我见面。

sentences.en: And I said, yes, sir.
sentences.zh: 我说，是的，先生。

sentences.en: I want to know why you are asking me to resign.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你们为什么要求我辞职。

sentences.en: And he said, oh, it's no question.
sentences.zh: 他说，哦，这毫无疑问。

sentences.en: We sent the photo to legal.
sentences.zh: 我们把照片发给法务部了。

sentences.en: Everyone has agreed.
sentences.zh: 大家都一致同意。

sentences.en: It's grounds for immediate termination.
sentences.zh: 这是立即予以解雇的理由。

sentences.en: There's no question.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问。

sentences.en: You're fired.
sentences.zh: 你被解雇了。

sentences.en: He continued to go on about how he can't believe I would post something like this.
sentences.zh: 他滔滔不绝地数落，说他简直不敢相信我会发这种东西。

sentences.en: He would never let his granddaughters post anything like this.
sentences.zh: 他是绝对不会让自己的孙女们发这种东西的。

sentences.en: You're seeking players' attention.
sentences.zh: 你在博取球员的关注。

sentences.en: Just kept going on about how terrible of a person I was.
sentences.zh: 一直数落我是个多么糟糕的人。

sentences.en: Like to be fired is one thing, but to sit there and have someone question your character and tell you how terrible you are because of a picture you posted.
sentences.zh: 被解雇是一回事，但坐在那里看着别人性质恶劣地质问你的人品，只因为你发了一张照片就说你有多糟糕。

sentences.en: Had you ever imagined that this could happen to you?
sentences.zh: 你以前想象过这种事会发生在自己身上吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: If you would have told me a year ago that this is how it was going to end, I wouldn't believe you.
sentences.zh: 如果一年前有人告诉我事情会以这种方式收场，我是绝对不会相信的。

sentences.en: Everything I'd worked for my whole life, the organization I had grown up around, people that worked for the Saints were considered my family.
sentences.zh: 我一生为之奋斗的一切、我从小到大生活的这个组织、圣徒队里工作的那些人，都被我视作家人。

sentences.en: They were all best friends with my mom.
sentences.zh: 他们和我妈妈都是最好的朋友。

sentences.en: They had all waited for the day that I was going to be on St. Stations.
sentences.zh: 他们都一直在等待我加入圣徒啦啦队的那一天。

sentences.en: And then to be told in that meeting that I was a bad representative, called my character into question,
sentences.zh: 然后在那场会议上却被告知我是一个糟糕的代表，人品受到了质疑，

sentences.en: I think that was what was so devastating.
sentences.zh: 我想那才是最令人崩溃的地方。

sentences.en: It's like my plans and my dreams had completely been crushed in that moment.
sentences.zh: 就好像我的计划和梦想在那一刻彻底粉碎了。

sentences.en: So what happens after this meeting?
sentences.zh: 所以开完这个会之后发生了什么？

sentences.en: They tell you, no question about it, grounds for termination, you're fired.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉你，毫无疑问，这就是开除的理由，你被解雇了。

sentences.en: After this meeting, we went in the car.
sentences.zh: 开完会后，我们上了车。

sentences.en: I tried not to cry in front of my mom because I didn't, you know, she was still employed by the Saints at this point.
sentences.zh: 我尽量不在我妈面前哭，因为我不想，你知道的，她当时还在圣徒队工作。

sentences.en: And I told her, you know, I wanted her to keep her job.
sentences.zh: 我告诉她，你知道的，我想让她保住工作。

sentences.en: I didn't want it to affect her at all.
sentences.zh: 我不想这事对她产生任何影响。

sentences.en: But she just says that what happened was wrong.
sentences.zh: 但她只是说发生这种事是不对的。

sentences.en: The rules need to be fixed.
sentences.zh: 这些规矩需要修改。

sentences.en: And she agrees the girls should be treated better.
sentences.zh: 而且她也同意女孩子应该得到更好的对待。

sentences.en: And we prayed about it.
sentences.zh: 我们为此祈祷了。

sentences.en: And we decided that for long term, this is what we needed to do because there needs to be a change.
sentences.zh: 我们决定从长远来看，这是我们必须要做的事，因为必须做出改变。

sentences.en: Is she still working there?
sentences.zh: 她还在那里工作吗？

sentences.en: No, she resigned right before we filed the complaint.
sentences.zh: 没有，我们在提交投诉前不久她就辞职了。

sentences.en: A former NFL cheerleader fighting back after allegedly being fired over an Instagram poSt.
sentences.zh: 一名美国国家橄榄球联盟的前啦啦队员据称因在Instagram发帖被解雇后奋起反击。

sentences.en: She's now claiming discrimination.
sentences.zh: 她现在指控遭到歧视。

sentences.en: Now she has filed a discrimination complaint with the EEOC.
sentences.zh: 目前她已向美国平等就业机会委员会（EEOC）提出了歧视投诉。

sentences.en: Now in a civil rights complaint with the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission, Davis argues the Saints have two sets of rules.
sentences.zh: 在向平等就业机会委员会提交的民权投诉中，戴维斯辩称圣徒队实行两套规则。

sentences.en: One for the players.
sentences.zh: 一套针对球员。

sentences.en: And an entirely different, more strict set of rules for its female cheerleaders.
sentences.zh: 而对女性啦啦队员则是一套完全不同、更加严格的规则。

sentences.en: For example, cheerleaders have to block players from their social media accounts.
sentences.zh: 例如，啦啦队员必须在社交媒体账号上拉黑球员。

sentences.en: They can never interact with players in person or online.
sentences.zh: 她们绝不能与球员进行任何线下或线上的互动。

sentences.en: They're not allowed to make eye contact with players if they come across a player in the tunnel.
sentences.zh: 如果她们在通道里偶遇球员，不允许与球员有眼神接触。

sentences.en: And are not allowed to eat in the same restaurant.
sentences.zh: 并且不允许在同一家餐厅吃饭。

sentences.en: Five years ago, it might have been different and certainly 20 years ago it would have been different.
sentences.zh: 五年前情况可能有所不同，二十年前当然也会不同。

sentences.en: But in 2018 and in color of the Me Too movement, as the NFL is kind of shifting its position here, so too should these franchises and likely these policies.
sentences.zh: 但在2018年，在“我也是”运动的背景下，随着美国国家橄榄球联盟正在改变立场，这些球队特许经营权以及这些政策也理应随之改变。

sentences.en: I can relate to it because I remember having some more experiences.
sentences.zh: 我对此深有同感，因为我记得也有过类似的经历。

sentences.en: So Bailey, after your story was reported, we started hearing from professional cheerleaders from all over the country.
sentences.zh: 所以拜利，在你的故事被报道后，我们开始听到来自全国各地的专业啦啦队员的声音。

sentences.en: During my time as a dancer slash cheerleader, you know, we would practice up to five times a week.
sentences.zh: 在我担任舞蹈演员兼啦啦队员期间，你知道的，我们一周最多要排练五次。

sentences.en: And a lot of them have very similar things to say.
sentences.zh: 她们当中很多人都有着非常类似的说法。

sentences.en: We did not get paid for practices.
sentences.zh: 我们排练是没有薪水的。

sentences.en: I think I made $500 for the whole year.
sentences.zh: 我想我一整年只赚了500美元。

sentences.en: It was $50 a game.
sentences.zh: 一场比赛只有50美元。

sentences.en: They complained about their low wages.
sentences.zh: 她们抱怨工资太低。

sentences.en: I remember sleeping in my car at my job because I was just exhausted.
sentences.zh: 我记得曾在工作时睡在车里，因为我实在是筋疲力尽。

sentences.en: At the beginning of the season, we felt like a nice yo weight.
sentences.zh: 在赛季刚开始时，我们感觉体重刚好合适。

sentences.en: I remember raising my hand and asking, okay, so I weigh 108 now.
sentences.zh: 我记得我举手问，好吧，我现在体重是108磅。

sentences.en: So you want me to weigh, you know, 102, 103?
sentences.zh: 所以你们是希望我体重保持在，你知道的，102、103磅吗？

sentences.en: She's like, yes.
sentences.zh: 她回答说，是的。

sentences.en: Being criticized for how they looked and how much they weighed.
sentences.zh: 因外表和体重而受到批评。

sentences.en: I also remember being told that I should wear two push-up bags.
sentences.zh: 我还记得有人告诉我说我应该戴两个聚拢胸垫。

sentences.en: And it looked like I had more cleavage.
sentences.zh: 这样看起来事业线更丰满一些。

sentences.en: We could not associate with the players at all.
sentences.zh: 我们绝对不能与球员有任何交往。

sentences.en: You know, if they were to go into a restaurant that we were in, we're supposed to leave.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，如果他们走进我们所在的餐厅，我们就得离开。

sentences.en: I was a bartender.
sentences.zh: 我曾是一名调酒师。

sentences.en: Anytime a player would come in, I would have to step off the floor for a little bit until that player was gone.
sentences.zh: 每当有球员进来，我都必须暂时离开工作区，直到那个球员离开。

sentences.en: And the restrictions on their social media and their behavior outside of the team.
sentences.zh: 还有对她们在社交媒体以及团队之外行为的种种限制。

sentences.en: You know, I've heard of things, you know, Lola, you signed up for that.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我听说过这种说法，劳拉，这是你自找的。

sentences.en: You know, you wore those skimpy outfits.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你穿了那些暴露的服装。

sentences.en: So when drunk men are heckling you in the stands, like, you signed up for that.
sentences.zh: 所以当喝醉的男人们在看台上对你起哄时，就像是，这是你自找的。

sentences.en: Crazy.
sentences.zh: 太疯狂了。

sentences.en: I'm this young kid that's in my 20s and I'm being told, I hope you get raped.
sentences.zh: 我这个二十多岁的年轻女孩却被告知，我希望你被强奸。

sentences.en: Like, okay, I abide by the rules or I quit, you know.
sentences.zh: 就像是，好吧，要么我遵守规矩，要么我辞职，你知道的。

sentences.en: Coaches are telling you, well, you know, if you quit, there's thousands of girls who wanted your spot.
sentences.zh: 教练会告诉你，好吧，你知道的，如果你不干了，有成千上万的女孩想要你的位置。

sentences.en: So what are you going to do?
sentences.zh: 所以你打算怎么办？

sentences.en: You give up your spot.
sentences.zh: 你放弃你的位置。

sentences.en: I mean, what's going to happen?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，会发生什么呢？

sentences.en: Nothing's going to change.
sentences.zh: 什么都不会改变。

sentences.en: You know, when I was a Saint-Sation, it didn't bother me.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，当我当圣徒啦啦队员的时候，这并没有困扰我。

sentences.en: Like, I didn't see how discriminating it was until I stepped back and I realized this can be so much better.
sentences.zh: 就像是，我没有看出这有多么歧视，直到我退后一步才意识到这一切本可以好得多。

sentences.en: These girls worked just as hard their whole lives to be cheerleaders as the football players did to be football players.
sentences.zh: 这些女孩为了成为啦啦队员而付出的毕生努力，一点也不比橄榄球运动员成为橄榄球运动员少。

sentences.en: Why are we treated differently?
sentences.zh: 为什么我们要受到不同的对待？

sentences.en: Why do we have all these extra rules to protect ourselves from these predators?
sentences.zh: 为什么我们要有这么多额外的规则来保护自己免受这些掠夺者的侵害？

sentences.en: Why can't they handle their own football players?
sentences.zh: 为什么他们就管不好自己的橄榄球球员呢？

sentences.en: But in one way, you sort of knew what you were getting into joining the team.
sentences.zh: 但在某种程度上，你加入球队时其实也知道会面临什么。

sentences.en: How do you feel about the people who say, like, you signed up for this?
sentences.zh: 你如何看待那些说“这都是你自找的”的人？

sentences.en: This is what it entails.
sentences.zh: 事情本来就是这样的。

sentences.en: Well, who wouldn't do anything to have their dream job?
sentences.zh: 好吧，为了得到梦寐以求的工作，谁不会付出一切呢？

sentences.en: I mean, it's your dream job.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是你的梦想工作。

sentences.en: You'll do anything to get there.
sentences.zh: 为了得到它，你愿意付出一切。

sentences.en: You'll do anything to keep your job.
sentences.zh: 为了保住工作，你愿意付出一切。

sentences.en: You know, no fraternization and leaving a restaurant.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，不能联谊以及离开餐厅。

sentences.en: If a player was there, that was normal.
sentences.zh: 如果球员在那里，那就是正常的。

sentences.en: You know, that was our normal.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，那是我们的常态。

sentences.en: You're in the organization.
sentences.zh: 你身处这个组织之中。

sentences.en: You don't see it from an outsider's point of view.
sentences.zh: 你不会从局外人的角度来看待它。

sentences.en: We knew there were certain bars we couldn't go to.
sentences.zh: 我们知道有些酒吧是不能去的。

sentences.en: We knew the restaurants they would go to.
sentences.zh: 我们知道他们会去哪些餐厅。

sentences.en: And we knew we had to stay away from these.
sentences.zh: 我们也知道必须远离这些地方。

sentences.en: Like I said, it was the normal.
sentences.zh: 就像我说的，这就是常态。

sentences.en: So we didn't question it.
sentences.zh: 所以我们不会去质疑它。

sentences.en: But that's an insane type of normal.
sentences.zh: 但这是一种极其变态的常态。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So I knew what I was doing when I signed the contract.
sentences.zh: 所以我签合同的时候知道自己在做什么。

sentences.en: But now that I'm on the outside, it can be better.
sentences.zh: 但现在我成了局外人，情况本可以更好。

sentences.en: You know, it doesn't have to stay this way.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，事情不必一直是这样。

sentences.en: They don't have to put up with these things.
sentences.zh: 她们不必默默忍受这些事情。

sentences.en: Today is my very first time trying out at the Saints station.
sentences.zh: 今天是我第一次参加圣徒啦啦队的选拔。

sentences.en: I'm so excited.
sentences.zh: 我太激动了。

sentences.en: And I really hope you enjoy what you see from me today.
sentences.zh: 我真心希望你们能喜欢我今天的表现。

sentences.en: Good evening, everyone.
sentences.zh: 大家晚上好。

sentences.en: My name is Amber.
sentences.zh: 我叫安珀。

sentences.en: I want to be a member of this team because it allows me to impact young girls.
sentences.zh: 我想成为这个团队的一员，因为它能让我对年轻女孩产生积极的影响。

sentences.en: I would love to be a Saints station because I love to perform.
sentences.zh: 我很想成为一名圣徒啦啦队员，因为我热爱表演。

sentences.en: I want to be a Saints station not only for the amazing opportunity.
sentences.zh: 我想成为圣徒啦啦队员不仅是因为这是一个绝佳的机会。

sentences.en: I want to be a Saints station because I love performing on a field.
sentences.zh: 我想成为圣徒啦啦队员是因为我热爱在赛场上表演。

sentences.en: And my reason for being a Saints station is because I just love inspiring people, especially young girls.
sentences.zh: 我成为圣徒啦啦队员的原因是我纯粹喜欢激励别人，尤其是年轻女孩。

sentences.en: It truly would be an honor to become part of this amazing organization.
sentences.zh: 能够成为这个伟大组织的一部分，绝对是我的荣幸。

sentences.en: It truly would be a blessing.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是一种福分。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: So, Bailey, it's April again.
sentences.zh: 那么，拜利，又到四月了。

sentences.en: And from what I understand, this year's tryouts for the Saints stations are right around the corner.
sentences.zh: 据我了解，今年圣徒啦啦队的选拔赛就在眼前了。

sentences.en: And I wonder what it's like for you to know that this is the first year in a while that you won't be there.
sentences.zh: 我想知道，得知这是你这段时间以来第一次不在现场，你心里是什么滋味？

sentences.en: I mean, it's really hard not getting ready for tryouts right now.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，现在不用为选拔赛做准备真的很难受。

sentences.en: And it feels very weird that I'm missing out on this.
sentences.zh: 而且错过了这一切，让我觉得非常奇怪。

sentences.en: Do you wish that you'd done anything differently?
sentences.zh: 你希望自己当初做出什么不同的选择吗？

sentences.en: In that moment, yes.
sentences.zh: 那一刻，是的。

sentences.en: I was like, Bailey, seriously, all you had to do was just not post that Instagram photo.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，拜利，说真的，你当时要做的就是别发那张Instagram照片。

sentences.en: And all this would be gone.
sentences.zh: 所有这些麻烦都不会有了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But now I'm glad it's all coming to light because I don't want anybody else to be treated like this.
sentences.zh: 但现在我很高兴这一切都曝光了，因为我不想让其他人再受到这种对待。

sentences.en: I don't want anybody else to be spoken down to like I was.
sentences.zh: 我不想让其他人再像我一样被人居高临下地训斥。

sentences.en: Bailey, would you encourage your daughter to be a Saints cheerleader in the same way that you followed in your mom's footsteps?
sentences.zh: 拜利，你会鼓励你的女儿成为一名圣徒啦啦队员吗，就像你当年效仿你妈妈的脚步一样？

sentences.en: If they change these rules and take care of their cheerleaders and respect us as athletes, yes, I will 100 percent encourage my daughter.
sentences.zh: 如果他们改变这些规则，照顾好他们的啦啦队员并将我们作为运动员来尊重，会的，我百分之百会鼓励我的女儿。

sentences.en: And that's why I'm doing this, because one day when a little girl comes up to me and says, I want to be a professional cheerleader, I want to tell her to go for it.
sentences.zh: 这就是我为什么要这么做，因为总有一天，当一个小女孩走到我面前说，我想成为一名职业啦啦队员，我想告诉她去追求吧。

sentences.en: You know, that's an amazing job.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这是一份很棒的工作。

sentences.en: But I want it to I want it to be an empowering job.
sentences.zh: 但我希望它，我希望它是一份能赋予女性力量的工作。

sentences.en: And right now it's not empowering women at all.
sentences.zh: 而现在它根本没有赋予女性任何力量。

sentences.en: Well, thank you so much, Bailey.
sentences.zh: 好的，非常感谢你，拜利。

sentences.en: I really appreciate your time.
sentences.zh: 我真的很感激你抽出时间。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Tryouts for next year's Saint Stations team begin this weekend.
sentences.zh: 明年圣徒啦啦队团队的选拔赛将于本周末开始。

sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: Is there confusion inside the administration on new sanctions toward Russia?
sentences.zh: 政府内部对于针对俄罗斯的新制裁是否存在困惑？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: I think the issue here is we have a set of sanctions and additional sanctions are under consideration but not been determined.
sentences.zh: 我认为这里的问题在于，我们已经实施了一套制裁，而追加制裁正在考虑中，但尚未最终确定。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, President Trump's chief economic advisor, Larry Kudlow, tried to explain why the White House has reversed course on new sanctions against Russia.
sentences.zh: 周二，特朗普总统的首席经济顾问拉里·库德洛试图解释为什么白宫在对俄新制裁问题上改变了立场。

sentences.en: The sanctions, announced on Sunday by U.N.
sentences.zh: 这些制裁于周日由联合国

sentences.en: Ambassador Nikki Haley, were intended to punish Russia for enabling its ally, Syria, to use chemical weapons.
sentences.zh: 大使妮基·黑利宣布，旨在惩罚俄罗斯支持其盟友叙利亚使用化学武器。

sentences.en: But by Monday, the White House had backtracked, saying the sanctions might not happen at all.
sentences.zh: 但到了周一，白宫却出尔反尔，称制裁可能根本不会发生。

sentences.en: And on Tuesday, Kudlow put the blame on Haley.
sentences.zh: 而在周二，库德洛将责任推卸给了黑利。

sentences.en: Why did the White House say the sanctions were coming on Monday?
sentences.zh: 为什么白宫周一会说制裁即将来临？

sentences.en: She got ahead of the curve.
sentences.zh: 她有点操之过急了。

sentences.en: She's done a great job.
sentences.zh: 她做得非常出色。

sentences.en: She's a very effective ambassador.
sentences.zh: 她是一位非常高效的大使。

sentences.en: There might have been some momentary confusion about that.
sentences.zh: 对此可能存在一些短暂的混乱。

sentences.en: Haley, in a statement on Tuesday night, said, With all due respect, I don't get confused.
sentences.zh: 黑利在周二晚间的一份声明中表示：恕我直言，我可不会糊涂。

sentences.en: The Times reports that members of the administration did intend to impose the sanctions.
sentences.zh: 据《时代》杂志报道，政府成员确实打算实施这些制裁。

sentences.en: But then President Trump rejected the idea.
sentences.zh: 但随后特朗普总统否决了这个想法。
